items.title: 1. Introduction to the Training Program
content: The academic programs at Tan Tao University School of Medicine are modeled on US medical education standards while fulfilling all regulations of the Vietnam Ministry of Education & Training and Ministry of Health.
Students build a rigorous foundation in basic sciences, pre-clinical skills, and bedside clinical medicine across 18+ tier-1 teaching hospitals in Ho Chi Minh City and Tan Tao University Hospital.
Emphasis is placed on Medical English, scientific inquiry, and comprehensive preparation for the United States Medical Licensing Examination (USMLE).

items.title: 2. International Accreditation & Recognition
content: Tan Tao University School of Medicine is listed in the World Directory of Medical Schools (WDOMS) with ECFMG sponsorship notes, enabling students and graduates to sit for USMLE Steps and apply for US Residency programs.

items.title: 3. Mission – Vision – Core Values – Educational Philosophy
content: Guided by the motto 'American Medicine – Hai Thuong Medical Ethics' and Liberal Arts education, we nurture healthcare professionals who combine modern scientific mastery with deep human compassion.

items.title: 4. Program Objectives
content: Educate Physicians (MD), Bachelor of Nursing graduates, and Medical Laboratory Technologists who possess strong clinical skills, professional ethics, English proficiency, and global mobility.

items.title: 5. Program Learning Outcomes (PLO)
content: Graduates meet national Ministry of Health competency standards, demonstrate professional English proficiency (IELTS 6.0–6.5+ equivalent), and engage in lifelong learning and clinical research.

items.title: 6. Admission Requirements
content: Open to domestic and international high school graduates meeting the Ministry of Education & Training's quality assurance threshold for Health Sciences programs.

items.title: 7. Credit Load & Duration
content: Doctor of Medicine (MD): 209 credits (6 years). Bachelor of Nursing: 135 credits (4 years). Bachelor of Medical Laboratory Technology: 135 credits (4 years).

items.title: 8. Curriculum Architecture
content: Comprises Liberal Arts & Medical English, Basic Sciences, Organ-System Pre-clinical Modules, Clinical Skills Lab (OSCE), Hospital Clerkships, and Graduation Thesis/Comprehensive Boards.

items.title: 9. Teaching & Learning Methodology
content: Utilizes Problem-Based Learning (PBL), Case-Based Learning (CBL), Bedside Teaching, Morning Reports, Journal Clubs, and high-fidelity clinical simulation.

items.title: 10. Student Assessment
content: Combines NBME/USMLE-style multiple-choice examinations, Objective Structured Clinical Examinations (OSCE), clinical logbooks, and oral case defenses.

accordionPart2.title: PART II. ACADEMIC & CLINICAL ROTATION GUIDELINES

items.title: 1. Liberal Arts & Medical English Foundation
content: Develops critical thinking, medical ethics, medical psychology, and fluency in reading international medical literature and communicating with patients in English.

items.title: 2. Pre-clinical Laboratories & 3D Anatomage Simulation
content: Students master anatomy on the 3D Anatomage virtual dissection table and wet specimens, and practice clinical procedures in the OSCE Simulation Center prior to hospital rotations.

items.title: 3. Hospital Clerkship Regulations
content: Clinical rotations take place at Tan Tao University Hospital and 18+ affiliated tier-1 hospitals in Ho Chi Minh City under the supervision of attending faculty.

items.title: 4. Graduation Requirements
content: Completion of all required credits, fulfillment of English proficiency standards, and passing the comprehensive theoretical-clinical graduation examination or thesis defense.

items.title: 5. International Clinical Clerkships (USA & Asia)
content: Outstanding students are selected for 4-to-8-week clinical clerkships at partner teaching hospitals in the United States, South Korea, and Taiwan.

about.title: About TTU School of Medicine
about.subtitle: School of Medicine – Tan Tao University (TTU SOM)
about.description: Founded to educate a new generation of internationally competent physicians, nurses, and medical laboratory scientists, Tan Tao University School of Medicine blends US medical education excellence with the timeless compassion of Hai Thuong Lan Ong.
about.heroImageAlt: White Coat Ceremony at Tan Tao University School of Medicine
about.heroMediaEyebrow: American Medicine – Hai Thuong Medical Ethics
about.heroMediaTitle: Shaping compassionate clinicians and global physician-scientists
about.heroMediaDescription: Doctor of Medicine (MD) · Bachelor of Nursing · Medical Laboratory Technology · USMLE
about.liberalArtsDescription: A liberal arts foundation cultivates critical clinical reasoning, ethical judgment, empathy for patients, and interdisciplinary problem-solving.
about.lifelongLearningDescription: Medical science evolves constantly. Our students develop habits of self-directed inquiry, keeping pace with global literature and practicing Evidence-Based Medicine.
about.qualityAssuranceDescription: Our bilingual, USMLE-integrated curriculum is listed in WDOMS and recognized by ECFMG, empowering graduates to pursue residency and practice worldwide.
about.facultyLevel: Professors, Assoc. Professors, PhDs & Specialist Physicians
about.technologyIntegrationDescription: Integrating the 3D Anatomage virtual dissection table, OSCE clinical simulation suites, and AI-assisted cardiovascular imaging into daily instruction.
about.transparentEnvironmentDescription: A rigorous, humane academic environment dedicated to scientific integrity and patient-first care inspired by Hippocrates and Hai Thuong Lan Ong.
about.readyToStart: Ready to begin your medical journey with us?
about.joinEcosystem: Join the community of future physicians and healthcare leaders at TTU School of Medicine.
about.historyText: Tan Tao University School of Medicine was established with the vision of bringing American-standard medical education to Vietnam. Under the leadership of Dean Prof. Thach Nguyen, MD, FACC, FSCAI and eminent Vietnamese medical educators including People's Teacher Prof. Le Hoang Ninh, Assoc. Prof. Pham Nguyen Vinh, Prof. Le Quang Nghia, and Prof. Le Van Cuong, TTU SOM has graduated cohorts of physicians, nurses, and laboratory specialists serving across Vietnam and the United States.
about.facultyText: Our faculty comprises internationally recognized Professors, Associate Professors, PhDs, and Specialist Level II Physicians from the United States and Ho Chi Minh City's premier teaching hospitals who mentor students in both lecture halls and hospital wards.
about.missionText: To educate high-quality healthcare professionals (Physicians, Nurses, and Medical Laboratory Technologists) who possess international-standard clinical competence, unwavering medical ethics, English fluency, and scientific research capability to advance public health.
about.visionText: To become a premier center of medical education and translational research in Vietnam and Southeast Asia modeled on US medical schools, where graduates excel in the USMLE and thrive in global healthcare institutions.
about.valuesText: Seven core values shaping the character and competence of every Tan Tao University healthcare professional.
about.philosophyText: American Medicine – Hai Thuong Medical Ethics

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.lede: Answers to the most common questions from prospective students and parents about academic programs, teaching hospitals, and USMLE preparation at TTU School of Medicine.

items.q: Which degree programs does Tan Tao University School of Medicine offer?
items.a: The School of Medicine offers 3 full-time undergraduate Health Sciences programs: (1) Doctor of Medicine – General Medicine (Code 7720101, 6 years), (2) Bachelor of Nursing (Code 7720301, 4 years), and (3) Bachelor of Medical Laboratory Technology (Code 7720601, 4 years).

items.q: How is the USMLE integrated into the Doctor of Medicine (MD) program?
items.a: TTU School of Medicine is listed in the World Directory of Medical Schools (WDOMS) and recognized by ECFMG. Our bilingual curriculum integrates USMLE Step 1 and Step 2 CK coursework, enabling students to earn a Vietnamese MD degree while qualifying to sit for USMLE exams and apply for US Residency.

items.q: Where do TTU medical and nursing students complete their clinical rotations?
items.a: Students practice on campus at Tan Tao University Hospital and rotate across 18+ premier tier-1 hospitals in Ho Chi Minh City, including Cho Ray Hospital, Binh Dan Hospital, People's Hospital 115, Children's Hospital 1 & 2, Tu Du Hospital, Hung Vuong Hospital, Military Hospital 175, Thong Nhat Hospital, and Nguyen Tri Phuong Hospital.

items.q: Are there opportunities for overseas clinical clerkships?
items.a: Yes. Each year, top-performing students with strong English proficiency are selected for 4-to-8-week clinical clerkships and observerships at partner hospitals in the United States (such as St. Mary Medical Center in Indiana and ChristianaCare in Delaware) as well as South Korea and Taiwan.

items.q: What pre-clinical laboratories and simulation facilities are available?
items.a: TTU SOM features the state-of-the-art 3D Anatomage Virtual Dissection Table, a gross anatomy cadaver laboratory, a full OSCE Clinical Skills Simulation Center (Internal Medicine, Surgery, OB/GYN, Pediatrics, ICU), and specialized Biochemistry, Microbiology, and Molecular Diagnostics laboratories.

items.q: What scholarships are available for incoming students?
items.a: Tan Tao University and the ITA For The Future Foundation award full and partial scholarships to high-achieving high school graduates, provincial/national academic competition winners, and continuing students who maintain outstanding GPAs.

items.q: Can undergraduate students participate in medical research?
items.a: Yes. From Years 1–2, students can join research groups mentored by Prof. Thach Nguyen and SOM faculty. Many students have co-authored papers in Q1 journals (including Nature Medicine, Circulation, and Frontiers) and presented at international cardiology conferences.

items.q: How do I apply or schedule a visit to the School of Medicine?
items.a: You can apply online via the TTU Admissions Portal (tuyensinh.ttu.edu.vn), email medicine@ttu.edu.vn, or call (+84) 272 376 9216 to receive personalized admissions counseling and book a campus tour.
